lang.subtitle: You fit change am anytime for Settings.
tour.welcome.title: Welcome to Shape.
tour.welcome.body: Make we waka small make you sabi where everything dey — like 30 seconds.
tour.home.title: Your day, for one eye.
tour.home.body: The next thing wey you go do, your food and your habits — everything dey for home screen.
tour.train.title: Today session.
tour.train.body: Your workout don ready make you start — your coach fit write am, or you fit build am yourself. Coach na your choice.
tour.eat.title: Food & logging.
tour.eat.body: Your plan for the day. Just tap one meal make you log am one time.
tour.grocery.title: Market list.
tour.grocery.body: The food wey you dey chop this week go turn shopping list, arrange by aisle — e dey build by imsef for you.
tour.habits.title: Habits for everyday.
tour.habits.body: Tick the small small things wey dey add up — every one dey feed your Shape Score.
tour.chat.title: Coaches & community.
tour.chat.body: Send message give your coaches and see wetin the community dey post.
tour.you.title: Your Shape Score.
tour.you.body: Your profile, how you dey go, and the one number wey dey talk true.
tour.radio.title: Shape Radio.
tour.radio.body: Workout mix wey no get advert, arrange by BPM. E free with your membership.
score.intro: Na one number for showing up. Everything wey you log dey feed am — and e dey climb as you dey consistent. Na the koko be this.
score.tiers.head: Climb the levels
score.tiers.body: Collect point make you climb — and once you reach one level, e no fit fall again.
score.tierPerk.form: You see drop first + streak boost
score.tierPerk.peak: You dey book first + 1 free intro / month
score.tierPerk.legend: Shape merch every year + credit for service
score.earn.head: How you fit collect am
score.earn.compoundsBody: — hold your momentum make the weekly bonus grow. Your Score page dey list every way wey you fit collect point.
score.spend.head: Spend wetin you collect
score.spend.body: Turn your point to real reward — session credit, gear and plenty more — for Shape Store. Spending no dey drop your rank at all.
score.protect.head: Guard your point
score.protect.body: Stay consistent make you keep dem. If you miss check-in or workout wey you promise, the number go drop small — but coach fit waive am anytime, and you no go ever go below 0.
